exportGitIdentity: alias.export-identity=!f() { git_dir=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; name=$(git config --get user.name 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; email=$(git config --get user.email 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; file="$git_dir/devcontainer-identity.gitconfig"; git config --file "$file" user.name "$name"; git config --file "$file" user.email "$email"; }; f

onCreateCommand.setupGit: set -eu; identity='${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.git/devcontainer-identity.gitconfig'; if [ -f "$identity" ]; then git config --global --add include.path "$identity" || true; fi; git config --global --add safe.directory '${containerWorkspaceFolder}'; git config --local core.autocrlf input

postCreateCommand.setupCodex:
set -eu; config_dir="$HOME/.codex"; config="$config_dir/config.toml"; mkdir -p "$config_dir"; sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$config_dir"; chmod 700 "$config_dir"; touch "$config"; if grep -q "^[[:space:]]*\[analytics\][[:space:]]*$" "$config"; then sed -i -e "/^[[:space:]]*\[analytics\][[:space:]]*$/,/^[[:space:]]*\[/{/^[[:space:]]*enabled[[:space:]]*=/d;}" -e "/^[[:space:]]*\[analytics\][[:space:]]*$/a enabled = false" "$config"; else printf "
[analytics]
enabled = false
" >> "$config"; fi
